test.method: exact two-sided paired binomial / McNemar on discordant outcomes

primary_endpoint.method: exact two-sided paired binomial / McNemar on discordant outcomes

interpretation: On the pre-registered fresh seeds 2000-2399, fixed V4-250 won 18/400 while WaterSpaceV3 won 8/400.
The paired discordant outcomes were 16 V4-only versus 6 WaterSpaceV3-only, with 2 shared wins and 376 shared losses.
The exact two-sided paired binomial/McNemar p-value is 0.052478790283203125, which is above the pre-declared 0.05 threshold.
Therefore the pre-declared classification is directionally positive but inconclusive; stability is not classified as confirmed on this holdout.

V4 remained substantially more compact (mean final open tunnels 15.0175; 61/400 at <=5) than WaterSpaceV3 (17.9; 17/400 at <=5), while WaterSpaceV3 placed EXIT more often and had more EXIT+equipment+water-ready end states.
Both policies had zero step_limit outcomes after the Worker #1 refresh-cycle correctness fix.
Observed win rates are holdout estimates, not final population win rates.
